title: Creator launch workspace
notes: Help small creator teams turn campaign ideas into a launch plan.
transcript: A launch workspace for small creator teams. It should turn scattered campaign ideas into a clear plan with owners, milestones, and reusable launch templates.

aiOutput.summary: Creator launch workspace is a focused product concept built around one clear outcome: help small creator teams turn campaign ideas into a launch plan. The strongest direction is to begin with a compact workflow, learn from real usage, and expand only after the core experience proves valuable.

keyIdeas.title: Lead with the core outcome
keyIdeas.detail: Help small creator teams turn campaign ideas into a launch plan.

keyIdeas.title: Validate before expanding
keyIdeas.detail: Test the smallest complete workflow with a focused group of early users.

keyIdeas.title: Build a repeatable loop
keyIdeas.detail: Capture feedback after every completed workflow and use it to improve the next iteration.

actionItems: Write the one-sentence product promise and success metric.
Recruit five target users for a structured usability test.
Review findings and commit to the next two-week milestone.
aiOutput.projectBrief: Build an initial version of Creator launch workspace that helps the target user complete one meaningful workflow with confidence. The product should feel calm, direct, and easy to understand. The MVP will be considered successful when users can reach the core outcome without assistance and clearly understand what to do next.
suggestedNextSteps: Confirm the primary user and their highest-friction moment.
Turn the core workflow into a five-screen prototype.
Define one behavior metric and one satisfaction metric.
